title: Judge output budget completes live Pilobolus scans
description:
## Intent

As a copy-editing agent, I want the OpenAI judge to finish structured output on published-length articles so `--require-judge` scan packets exist for HITL.

## Context

Live HITL scan of published Pilobolus (`wiki-janitor`, `you-confessed-to-a-bag-of-numbers`) failed after ~35s:

`JudgeUnavailableError` / `OpenAI editorial rewrite response was incomplete (reason: max_output_tokens)`

`_call_openai_judge` hard-codes `max_output_tokens=2400`. Prompt v2 plus a required rubric (five dimensions with evidence spans) plus findings exceeds that on real articles. Truncation is correctly treated as failure (no partial JSON). Always-lane packets were unchanged; no `scan-judge.json` was written.

## Gherkin

```gherkin
Feature: Judge output budget
  As a copy-editing agent
  I want the OpenAI judge token budget to fit findings plus rubric
  So live --require-judge scans complete instead of truncating

  Scenario: Judge call uses a named budget large enough for rubric plus findings
    Given the default OpenAI judge lane
    When it calls the structured Responses API
    Then max_output_tokens is a named judge budget, not an unexplained 2400
    And truncation still raises without returning partial JSON

  Scenario: Unit tests pin the budget without live OpenAI
    Given mocked Responses API
    When the default judge lane runs
    Then the request uses the documented judge output budget
```

## DoD

- Named constant (and budget helper if draft length should scale); no magic 2400.
- Truncation still fails closed; do not accept incomplete payloads.
- Tests without live OpenAI.
- No `project/` in the product PR. PR to Limatus `main`.
- Do not drop required `rubric` from the schema (that 400 is already fixed).
- Do not bump `JUDGE_PROMPT_VERSION` unless the prompt text changes.

## Out of scope

- LIM-ed02c3 image-alt 4-gram detector.
- Newsroom UI. Detector evasion. Applying patches.
